statement:
The record gives M. Reyes’s account status as “open, extended for 12 months.”
M. Reyes’s account status has been set to closed.
judge_text:
WRONG

It rejects the recorded "open, extended for 12 months" status and supplies the correct value instead: "M. Reyes's account status has been set to closed."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
